searchRecords.title: Add structure to your content
searchRecords.markdownContent: Now that you’ve switched to a headless CMS, it’s more important than ever to understand how to unleash its superpowers. The secret is to use structured and linked content.

searchRecords.title: Manage your API keys securely

searchRecords.title: Automate content migrations with CLI
searchRecords.markdownContent:

This course will guide you through our sample boilerplate migration scripts that you can use to create migration scripts suitable for your organization.

searchRecords.title: Before you model content

This learning path will walk you through all the handy prerequisites, things to know about modeling, and tools to help you through the process.

searchRecords.title: Start building apps

searchRecords.title: Decide your navigation and URL structure

searchRecords.title: Understand omnichannel content strategy
searchRecords.markdownContent: Today's customers expect seamless access to your content, whether they’re at a desk, on the go with a smartphone, or using a voice assistant in their car. Crafting a robust omnichannel content strategy is essential to meet these expectations. Let’s explore how to create a strategy that ensures your content reaches your audience, no matter where they are.

searchRecords.title: Content creation: First steps
searchRecords.markdownContent: Ready to make your first creative steps in Kontent.ai? In this path, you’ll discover how to create a content item and use the available tools to compose text ;efficiently, insert images and other media, and preview the results of your efforts. All that in less time than what a usual coffee break takes!

searchRecords.title: Content creator’s role in content modeling
searchRecords.markdownContent: Content modeling is typically the main task for managers and developers. However, it’s essential that content creators pitch in with their knowledge so that the configuration is set up correctly. This way, the company gets a smooth workflow while you, as a content creator, get well-structured and friction-free content management.

searchRecords.title: Create your first content model
searchRecords.markdownContent: Creating a quality content model is key to a successful content strategy. Yet, knowing all the ins and outs is far from easy. This learning path will take you through the steps of modeling content individually. If you follow this guide, you’ll get a suitable content model for your business or at least a sound basis for one.

Kickstart for developers

searchRecords.title: Digital and content maturity
searchRecords.markdownContent:
Enterprises strive to craft personalized content but frequently duplicate efforts due to a lack of maturity in content management. Enhancing maturity can streamline processes, save resources, and improve content creation.

Find out how to avoid this by learning why maturity is an important topic, how to assess your organization’s maturity, and find ways to improve it.

searchRecords.title: Establish content workflows
searchRecords.markdownContent: Well-designed workflows keep your content moving smoothly from draft to publish while ensuring the right people handle each step. In this path, you’ll learn how to plan workflows that match your organization’s needs, define steps and transitions, assign the right roles, and configure everything in Kontent.ai.

searchRecords.title: Get modeling inspiration from others
searchRecords.markdownContent:
Content modeling isn’t an exact science, and there will always be pioneers, as well as companies, that use anti-patterns for their advantage.

Most companies don’t make their content models public. Look into the examples of what others have successfully used and draw ideas for your own solutions.

searchRecords.title: Master the art of taxonomies
searchRecords.markdownContent:
Taxonomies are suitable for anything that you can imagine as a drop-down picker. Brands, divisions, topics, and others can be modeled as taxonomies because you categorize your content in some way.

When creating a quality content model, taxonomies are a must-have and you cannot create a fully functional content model for enterprise-level companies without taxonomies.

searchRecords.title: Master the art of modular content

searchRecords.title: Move content through the workflow

searchRecords.title: Optimize performance

What makes a great user experience apart from visuals and interactions? Speed and reliability. People love snappy experiences that work right when they need them. Make your applications fast by optimizing their performance.

The golden rule to improve your app’s performance is to retrieve only what you need and then store it for as long as necessary.

searchRecords.title: Enhance SEO for websites

searchRecords.title: Account settings
searchRecords.markdownContent:
**Explore your path to mastery**

* Get familiar with Kontent.ai through our Walkthrough for content creators.

## Change your profile image

To manage your profile image, you need a Gravatar account set up using the same email address as your Kontent.ai account.

If you don’t have a Gravatar account associated with your Kontent.ai account’s email address, your profile image will be your name initials. For example, a person named _Sofie Peletier_ gets a profile image with the letters _SP_.

To set up your Gravatar account:

1. Open [Gravatar](https://gravatar.com/).
2. Click **Get Started Now**.
3. Enter the email address that you use to sign in to Kontent.ai.
4. Continue following the instructions to set up your Gravatar account.

Once you’re done, your Kontent.ai profile image will match your avatar image in Gravatar.

## Change your name

1. Click ;your initials in the bottom left corner.
2. Click **Profile details**.
3. Change your **First name** and **Last name**.
4. Click **Update profile** to save your changes.

Kontent.ai displays your name in the app, for example, when comparing content item versions or in user management. We also use your name on certificates that you can get in Kontent.ai Learn.

**Is your content still under your former name?**

Typically, there's a content item that describes you as an author. Look up that content item with your former name and publish a new version with your new name.

## Change your password

1. Click ;your initials in the bottom left corner.
2. Click **Profile details**.
3. Click **Select new password**.

To ensure the highest security, you don’t change your password directly in Kontent.ai. Instead, Kontent.ai sends you an email to your inbox. You’ll find a link to change your password there.

Ensure that the password reset email has been sent by Kontent.ai to avoid possible phishing attempts.

**Using** **single sign-on** **?**

If you see _Single Sign-On enabled_ when signing in to Kontent.ai, you don't have a password for Kontent.ai. To change your password, change it in your identity provider.

### Password strength requirements

When choosing a new password for your account, make sure your password meets these criteria:

* Contains at least 10 characters.
* Contains at least three of the following four types of characters:  
  * Lowercase letters (a-z)
  * Uppercase letters (A-Z)
  * Numbers (0-9)
  * Special characters (!@#$%^&\*)

## Choose your notifications

Your email notification settings apply to all projects you have access to.

1. Click your initials in the bottom left corner.
2. Click **Profile details**.
3. Under **Email preferences**, select what notifications you’d like to receive:  
  * Workflow changes – A content item assigned to you had its workflow step changed.
  * Comments – A new comment was added to a content item assigned to you.
  * Mentions – You were mentioned in a comment.
  * Tasks – You were assigned a task in a content item.
  * Usage reports with a total price of $0.
  * Webhook notifications.
4. Click ;**Update preferences** to save your preferences.

## Manage multifactor authentication

Multifactor authentication (MFA) is an additional layer of security that verifies your identity. You can sign in using an authenticator app, like Google Authenticator.

1. Click your initials in the bottom left corner.
2. Click **Profile details**.
3. Under **Multifactor authentication**,you can:  
  * Activate or deactivate MFA for your account
  * Reset to switch to a new device

## Change your email

Your email address is tied to your account because it serves as a sign-in to Kontent.ai. It cannot be changed.

**No longer need your account?**

If you wish to delete your Kontent.ai account, contact our support team using the chat button in the bottom right and we will remove the account for you.

## Sign out

There are two options for you to sign out of Kontent.ai:

* Sign out – ;sign out of the current browser you're currently signed in.
* Sign out everywhere – sign out of all browsers on all devices you're signed in.

Complete sign-out from other browsers will take up to 10 minutes.

searchRecords.markdownContent: Are you experiencing any problems accessing the Kontent.ai app located at [app.kontent.ai](https://app.kontent.ai) or with any API? Check the following tips that can help you troubleshoot this problem.

searchRecords.title: Troubleshooting access
searchRecords.markdownContent:
## Is Kontent.ai down?

One of the key features of Kontent.ai is stable availability. Based on your [subscription plan](https://kontent.ai/pricing), you may also have an availability guarantee of Kontent.ai's uptime.

If there's any problem with our services, **see the** [**Kontent.ai status page**](https://status.kontent.ai/) **to check the availability** of Kontent.ai and its APIs.

## Suitable browsers and devices

To run Kontent.ai, you need to meet the minimum requirements. If you’re experiencing problems working with the Kontent.ai app, check the following advice:

* To provide the best experience possible, we guarantee that the latest versions of the widely-used browsers are fully operational with Kontent.ai:
* We recommend using a device with the Full HD resolution (1920x1080px) or higher. But you can access all functionality with a screen at least 1024px wide.
* To access all functionality of Kontent.ai, use a device with a mouse and a keyboard. You can do some authoring and editorial tasks with touch-first devices. In such a case, we recommend using the landscape mode.
* Even though we're trying to cover all situations when you experience Internet connection outages, you can only get the best experience with a stable connection.

## Can't sign in?

As of October 17, 2022, our identity provider, [Auth0 by Okta](https://www.auth0.com/), prohibits people located in Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria, and the Ukrainian regions of Crimea, Luhansk, and Donetsk from signing in to Kontent.ai due to US regulations.

## Still no luck?

If you've checked the things above and you're still experiencing problems, we're happy to assist you using our support chat button. Here, it's located in the bottom right corner. You can also find the chat button directly in the [Kontent.ai app](https://app.kontent.ai) in the bottom left corner.

You can get different levels of our support based on your subscription plan. Check out how our [Premium Support](https://kontent.ai/premium-support) works to get a guaranteed SLA for your questions.

searchRecords.title: Accessibility in Kontent.ai
searchRecords.markdownContent: Kontent.ai is the only CMS that meets WCAG 2.2 Level AA accessibility standards and aligns with EN 301 549\. The platform provides enhanced keyboard navigation, screen reader compatibility, improved color contrast, and better compatibility across assistive technologies.

searchRecords.title: Accessibility in Kontent.ai
searchRecords.markdownContent:
## Why accessibility matters

Digital accessibility ensures content reaches all users, including the 1.3 billion people worldwide who experience significant disabilities. For organizations in regulated industries and the public sector, accessibility is also a procurement and compliance requirement.

Benefits of accessible digital experiences include:

* **Procurement and compliance** – Meet WCAG 2.2 AA standards and provide documented proof of compliance, reducing friction in procurement reviews and regulatory audits.
* **Higher team productivity** – Enable employees with visual, motor, or cognitive impairments to fully participate in content work without workarounds or exclusions.
* **AI-assisted content validation** – Prevent accessibility violations before publishing using AI and agentic capabilities throughout the content creation process.

## How Kontent.ai is accessible

Kontent.ai includes built-in accessibility capabilities to help you create and manage content efficiently:

### Streamlined navigation

Menu subsections appear directly in the left-hand navigation bar, making it easier to find what you need. You can expand or collapse the side navigation to suit your preferences.

### Enhanced keyboard navigation

Navigate through Kontent.ai using keyboard shortcuts without requiring a mouse. Interactive elements are accessible via keyboard controls.

### Screen reader compatibility

The platform works seamlessly with screen readers, ensuring users who rely on assistive technologies can access all features and content.

### Flexible filters

Filters appear in an expandable menu below the search bar, which you can collapse to create more screen real estate while maintaining easy access to filtering options.

### Improved color contrast

The interface meets color contrast requirements, ensuring text and interactive elements remain visible and readable for users with visual impairments.

## Accessibility resources

Access detailed accessibility information in the [Kontent.ai Trust Center](https://trustcenter.kontent.ai/ "Kontent.ai Trust Center"):

* **Accessibility conformance report** – Review the complete [WCAG 2.2 Level AA conformance report](https://trustcenter.kontent.ai/?itemUid=0b500d3b-6d5b-476d-9c94-8a44c81cec07) and EN 301 549 compliance details
* [**Web accessibility checker**](https://github.com/butcher-07/accessibility-checker) – A tool that identifies and resolves WCAG compliance issues across your web content using Axe-core technology. ;
* **FAQ** – Find common questions and answers regarding compliance and accessibility
