searchRecords.title: Language fallbacks for linked content
searchRecords.markdownContent:
You can now choose from two language fallback behaviors for Delivery API.

* The default fallback behavior aims for language consistency of the returned content. You get linked content only if it's translated into the same language as the parent content item.
* The opt-in fallback behavior aims for independent evaluation of language fallbacks for every linked content item. You might get linked content even if it isn't translated into the same language as the parent content item.

Let us know if you'd like to opt-in for language fallbacks for linked content.

searchRecords.title: Faster revision comparing
searchRecords.markdownContent: Comparing revisions of content items is now significantly faster for larger items with a lot of rich text elements.

searchRecords.title: Filter and retrieve content items with variants
searchRecords.markdownContent:
The Content items with variants section is now available in the Management API reference, introducing two endpoints that replace the former Early Access endpoint.

The new endpoints work as a pair:

* **Filter items with language variants** – returns item and language references matching your filter criteria
* **Bulk get items with variants** – retrieves full content item data and language variants for the references returned in the first step

This two-step approach lets you filter large datasets without pulling unnecessary data upfront, then fetch full details only for the items you need.

searchRecords.title: Filtering by custom element value in Delivery API
searchRecords.markdownContent: You can use content filtering on the value of custom elements if their value is a stringified array of strings in JSON format. For example, for a custom element with the value of `"[\"ABC\",\"DAC\",\"CMS\"]"`, you can use a filter such as `element.custom[contains]=ABC`.

searchRecords.title: Improved filtering of your users
searchRecords.markdownContent:
User listings in your project and subscription now show only active users by default. If needed, you can still apply filters to see deactivated users as well.

This is to make your user management clearer, as only active users count to the user quota of your subscription.

searchRecords.title: Find out why content strategy is important
searchRecords.markdownContent: Our learning path Understand omnichannel content strategy introduces content strategy and other related areas. You’ll find out about typical problems from absent or not-working content strategy and how headless CMSs help address these issues. The course is primarily aimed at partner agencies, system architects, and starting content strategists.

searchRecords.title: Find your projects faster with favourites
searchRecords.markdownContent: Now you can mark any project as a favourite and it appears at the top of your project list – ;right where you need it.

searchRecords.title: Faster builds with Gatsby stack updates
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We've released ;[version 8](https://github.com/Kentico/kontent-gatsby-packages/releases/tag/8.0.0) ;of our ;[Gatsby packages](https://github.com/Kentico/kontent-gatsby-packages) supporting [Gatsby 4](https://www.gatsbyjs.com/gatsby-4/). Here's what's new:

* Support for [deferred static generation (DSG)](https://www.gatsbyjs.com/docs/how-to/rendering-options/using-deferred-static-generation) and [server-side rendering (SSR)](https://www.gatsbyjs.com/docs/how-to/rendering-options/using-server-side-rendering). See [example of the new rendering options](https://github.com/Kentico/kontent-gatsby-packages/tree/master/examples/dsg-ssr#readme).
* Reduced build times by filtering out the data you don't need on your site from the GraphQL model.

searchRecords.title: New features in Gatsby stack
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We've released [version 7.2](https://github.com/Kentico/kontent-gatsby-packages/releases/tag/7.2.0) of our [Gatsby packages](https://github.com/Kentico/kontent-gatsby-packages). You can now use TypeScript in Kontent Gatsby React components.

For the early adopters among you, there's also a new experimental feature for triggering incremental builds by changing a workflow step. This is useful for content previews and should lower your update queue.

searchRecords.title: Say hi to Delivery GraphQL API
searchRecords.markdownContent:
Get exactly the data you request with the new Delivery GraphQL API. Using GraphQL for content delivery can improve the efficiency of content queries, prevent over-fetching, and help support modern tech stacks.

You can use the Delivery GraphQL API as an alternative to the Delivery REST API in your apps. The new API is automatically available for Kontent.ai projects in select subscription plans.

searchRecords.title: Improvements to Delivery GraphQL API
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We've added several enhancements to the Delivery GraphQL API.

* Secure access – Make secured requests with an API key.
* Preview content – Get the latest content from your projects with a Preview API key.
* Ordering – Use the new `order` argument in root queries to retrieve your content items in a specific order.
* AND and OR operators – Combine multiple filters to make spot-on queries.
* Extended filterable system fields – Filter your content items by codename, internal ID, and their language.

searchRecords.title: Add a profile image with Gravatar
searchRecords.markdownContent:
Collaboration just got more personal – set up your profile image with Gravatar.

Kontent.ai automatically uses Gravatar profile images whenever users have Gravatar profiles set up with the same email address. Give it a try!

searchRecords.title: Nest headings up to six levels deep
searchRecords.markdownContent:
On November 9, we're adding support for two more levels of headings in Kontent.ai. You'll be able to use the new heading levels in Kontent.ai, Management API, and SDKs.

Are you using the .NET Management SDK to manage content types with rich text elements? Do you use rich text limitations? If so, **you need to** [**update the .NET Management SDK ;to version 4.2.0 or higher**](https://github.com/kontent-ai/management-sdk-net/releases/tag/4.2.0 "Kontent.ai Management .NET SDK on GitHub") **before November 9** to keep your code working. Take care that starting with version 4.0.0, only .NET 6 is supported.

In any case, prepare your app for the new heading levels. They'll be enabled by default in new content types and any existing rich text elements without limitations regarding headings or lists.

Please contact us if you have any questions about this update or need any help.

searchRecords.title: Check your webhook's health status via API
searchRecords.markdownContent: With Management API v2, you can now check the health status of your webhooks. This means there's now a new `health_status` property that tells you if the webhook is operational, failing, or inactive.

searchRecords.title: Customize images to create the perfect fit
searchRecords.markdownContent:
You can now customize images linked from the asset element directly in Kontent.ai. This can be especially useful when the image does not meet the limitations set for the element, and you need to adjust the image. There’s no need to upload multiple versions of the same asset anymore, customize your images within a few clicks.

Developers need to apply customization query parameters to the asset's original URL in order to display customized images on the web. When retrieving content via Delivery API, you can find the details about the customized image in the `renditions` object property of the Asset element object.

searchRecords.title: Image resolution in Delivery API
searchRecords.markdownContent: Extended the asset model with the `width` and `height` properties. This applies to assets used in the _Asset_ and _Rich text_ elements. With this enhancement, you can, for example, render placeholders for images in your application before the assets themselves are loaded.

searchRecords.title: Stay on track with improved lesson instructions
searchRecords.markdownContent: We’ve made it easier to track your learning progress! With new UI messages in each lesson, you’ll now know exactly which interactive elements, like videos, questions, and other activities, need to be completed before marking a lesson as done. This ensures a smoother experience and helps you stay on top of your learning journey.

searchRecords.title: Improved scheduled publishing experience
searchRecords.markdownContent:
Scheduling your content just got more flexible! You can now quickly (re)schedule the publish and unpublish dates of your content items in one go whenever necessary. With these improvements, planning seasonal content, such as marketing campaigns, becomes even easier.

You can also use API to schedule publish and unpublish dates for your content items.

searchRecords.title: Better readability of audit log events
searchRecords.markdownContent: The information you see in your audit log events has been rearranged for better readability.

searchRecords.title: Improvements to webhook notification emails
searchRecords.markdownContent:
The emails you get when webhook notifications can't reach your app newly include the environment where the notification came from. This will help you resolve webhook issues faster.

Also, if you're not interested in receiving emails about webhooks, you can now opt out in your user profile.

searchRecords.title: Including images in the Guideline element
searchRecords.markdownContent: You can now add images to the _Guidelines_ element to advise your content editor more effectively when they're creating content.

searchRecords.title: Increased query complexity limit for Delivery GraphQL API
searchRecords.markdownContent: To support more complex content queries with Delivery GraphQL API, we increased the query complexity limit to 2000\. The limit represents the maximum number of content items and components your query can return.

searchRecords.title: Increased performance of Delivery REST API
searchRecords.markdownContent:
The Delivery API responses are now 30% smaller and 50% faster. This is possible thanks to minimizing the JSON responses and changing the way they're serialized.

Don't worry, nothing changes for your apps. You still get the same JSON responses as before, they just aren't pretty printed.

searchRecords.title: Item's workflow info in revisions and the calendar
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We've added information about the workflow of your content items to two new places:

* A content item's revision list
* An item's detail in the editorial calendar

searchRecords.title: Bridge AI and Kontent.ai with the new MCP server
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We’re excited to introduce **Kontent.ai’s** **MCP server**, a new tool designed to connect Kontent.ai with AI models through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). With this server, your AI model or agent (like Claude or Cursor) can understand and interact with your project’s content model directly, opening the door to intelligent automation, creative content generation, and more.

What can you do with the MCP server today?

* Enable AI models to access and interpret your content model in real time.
* Let AI create content types, snippets, and taxonomies using the MCP specification.
* Seamlessly integrate any MCP-compatible AI system with Kontent.ai.

To get started, check out the tool’s [GitHub repository](https://github.com/kontent-ai/mcp-server) for setup instructions and implementation details. Then visit the documentation to explore practical use cases.

searchRecords.title: Dive deep into your content model with our new model visualizer!
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We’re thrilled to announce the release of our first official custom application, content model visualizer! This app allows you to inspect your content model interactively and is seamlessly integrated into Kontent.ai.

And what can you do with the content model visualizer?

* View the automatically laid out relationship diagram of your content model.
* Isolate a subset of content types that are related.
* Track where taxonomies and snippets are used in your project.

Check out the tool’s [GitHub repository](https://github.com/kontent-ai/model-visualizer "Model Visualizer GitHub") for further information on its capabilities, setup, and available configuration.

searchRecords.title: Introducing Sync API v2
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We’re excited to release Sync API v2, the next evolution of our synchronization capabilities. With Sync API v2, you get more granular, precise insights into what’s changed in your project.

In line with our new webhooks implementation, Sync API v2 tracks and returns changes only to the objects that were actually updated, such as content items, content types, taxonomies, and languages. It no longer includes related dependencies, resulting in smaller payloads, cleaner data, and simpler processing in your integration.

The original Sync API v1 is now deprecated and remains available only to existing users. All projects still using version 1 must migrate to Sync API v2 by **December 31, 2025**. We recommend making the switch early to take full advantage of the improvements and avoid disruption.

searchRecords.title: One click to sign out everywhere
searchRecords.markdownContent:
You can sign out from all browsers on all devices simultaneously with one click. This security enhancement keeps your account secure across all platforms while adding convenience to account management.

Complete sign-out on other browsers takes up to 10 minutes.

searchRecords.title: Changes to codenames of content items in the Management API
searchRecords.markdownContent: Added support for setting codenames when creating or updating content items via the Management API. To avoid breaking changes in version 1 of the API, updating the `name` property of an item causes the codename to autogenerate based on the new name. In version 2, the codename remains unchanged.

searchRecords.title: Quickly find unlabeled items
searchRecords.markdownContent:
Consistent content labeling is important. With the new _Not in_ filter, you can quickly find unlabeled content items.

For example, if you need to find items that aren't labeled by a taxonomy called _Continents_, you'd select _∅ Not in Continents_ from the list of filters.

searchRecords.title: Track publishing success with our new widget
New version of Java SDK and model generator
searchRecords.markdownContent:
The Java Delivery SDK and its model generator were updated to a new version. The updated SDK requires Java 8+ to work correctly.

Also, multiple Java packages were merged into [one repository](https://github.com/kontent-ai/java-packages#packages) that now contains:

* [Kontent model generator for Java](https://github.com/kontent-ai/java-packages/tree/master/delivery-sdk-generators#readme) package
* [Kontent Delivery Java SDK](https://github.com/kontent-ai/java-packages/tree/master/delivery-sdk#readme) – updated, rebranded, and completely asynchronous. See the [list of breaking changes](https://github.com/kontent-ai/java-packages/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md#changes-in-v3---v4 "java-packages/CHANGELOG.md at master · kontent-ai/java-packages · GitHub").
* Sample apps using the new Java SDK  
  * [Sample Java console app](https://github.com/kontent-ai/java-packages/blob/master/test-gradle-console-app#readme)
  * [Sample Spring Boot Console App](https://github.com/kontent-ai/java-packages/blob/master/sample-app-spring-boot#readme) – [Springboot](https://spring.io/projects/spring-boot) ;sample app using ;the [Thymeleaf](https://www.thymeleaf.org/) ;templating engine

searchRecords.title: Java SDK is moving to Maven Central
searchRecords.markdownContent:
Since JFrog decided to [sunset the Bintray and jCenter services](https://jfrog.com/blog/into-the-sunset-bintray-jcenter-gocenter-and-chartcenter/), [Java Delivery SDK](https://github.com/kontent-ai/java-packages/tree/master/delivery-sdk) and Java Model Generators were migrated to Maven Central. From now on, all newly released versions will be published on Maven Central.  
  
Check out [the pull request](https://github.com/Kentico/kontent-java-packages/pull/131) for more information. ;

searchRecords.title: Java Delivery SDK renamed
searchRecords.markdownContent: In relation to the recent rebranding to Kentico Kontent, the Java Delivery SDK package was updated to reflect the new naming and is now available at <https://github.com/Kentico/kontent-delivery-sdk-java>.

searchRecords.title: JavaRx Delivery SDK deprecated
searchRecords.markdownContent: The JavaRx Delivery SDK is no longer being maintained and has been deprecated. We recommend using the [Kontent Java Delivery SDK](https://github.com/kontent-ai/java-packages/tree/master/delivery-sdk) ;as a substitute. If you used the JavaRx SDK for Android development, see how to [use the Java SDK for Android](https://github.com/kontent-ai/java-packages/blob/master/delivery-sdk/README.md#android-development).

searchRecords.title: Improvements to Javascript Management SDK
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We've released a new version of the [JavaScript Management SDK](https://github.com/Kentico/kontent-management-sdk-js) that comes with several improvements.

* Added support for new Management API v2 endpoints such as collections.
* Simplified retry strategy configuration.
* Reduced SDK size by 30-40% by removing Rxjs peer dependency.

See the [full list of changes](https://github.com/Kentico/kontent-management-sdk-js/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md#features) as well as [the migration guide](https://github.com/Kentico/kontent-management-sdk-js/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md#migration-from-0xy) on GitHub.

searchRecords.title: Improved API key management
searchRecords.markdownContent:
Say hello to a new way to manage your API keys!

* Easily find all your project’s API keys in one place. Newly, you’ll find the keys in Project settings > API keys.
* Audit who can access which API in a transparent way.
* Create Delivery API keys scoped to multiple environments and share the keys with your colleagues.

This is one of the first steps toward better API management. Stay tuned for more later this year!

searchRecords.title: Renamed JavaScript packages
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We've migrated the following Kontent.ai JavaScript open source packages under a new organization on [npmjs.com](https://www.npmjs.com/). This means the package names are now different and their major versions increased. We recommend that you use the latest package versions in your apps.

* [@kontent-ai/core-sdk](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@kontent-ai/core-sdk)
* [@kontent-ai/delivery-sdk](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@kontent-ai/delivery-sdk)
* [@kontent-ai/management-sdk](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@kontent-ai/management-sdk)
* [@kontent-ai/model-generator](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@kontent-ai/model-generator)
* [@kontent-ai/webhook-helper](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@kontent-ai/webhook-helper)
* [@kontent-ai/backup-manager](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@kontent-ai/backup-manager)

For a comprehensive list of changes in the packages, check the changelog files in the packages' GitHub repositories.

searchRecords.title: Say hello to Kontent.ai
searchRecords.markdownContent: In our new e-learning course – Hello Kontent.ai, you’ll get familiar with various parts of the Kontent.ai app. The course is primarily for those who work with content directly, such as content creators and content managers. You'll learn how to find the content you need, what you can do inside a content item, or what content modeling looks like in Kontent.ai.

searchRecords.title: Take your authoring experience to the next level
searchRecords.markdownContent: In our new e-learning course – Authoring in Kontent.ai, you’ll learn how to use the Kontent.ai app as an authoring tool to create meaningful content. The course is primarily aimed at content creators and people collaborating on content creation in Kontent.ai. You’ll learn how to create new content, add structure to it, send it for review, prepare it for publishing, and more! ;

searchRecords.title: Kontent.ai Learn has a dark theme now!
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We’ve got some great news for lovers of dark themes. Starting today, you can head over to [Your learning settings](/learn/profile/settings "User profile | Kontent.ai Learn") and customize the appearance of Kontent.ai Learn.

In **My preferred theme** drop-down menu, you have three options to choose from:

* **Light**: the bright white theme you’re used to.
* **Dark**: the new dimmed owls-friendly theme.
* **Match system**: Kontent.ai Learn looks into your operating system settings and decides which option to pick based on your system-wide theme.

The changes you make in your Learn profile settingsare applied immediately. You need to refresh any opened tabs manually.

Some API references, such as Management API or Delivery API, are exempt from the theme setting and always use the dark theme.

searchRecords.title: Keep all your assets neatly organized
searchRecords.markdownContent:
With your asset library growing each day, it’s easy to lose track of what’s actually in it. Asset taxonomies help you stay on top of your assets.

Create an asset taxonomy based on your needs to organize assets by regions, teams, descriptive tags, and more. Find relevant assets without any hassle and make asset management a breeze!

Get in touch with us, or check out our [pricing page](https://kontent.ai/pricing) for more details.

searchRecords.title: Kontent.ai acheives WCAG 2.1 level AA compliance
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We’re thrilled to announce that the [Kontent.ai](https://kontent.ai) platform now meets **WCAG 2.1 Level AA** accessibility standards. This achievement ensures our platform is accessible to everyone, including individuals who depend on assistive technologies.

This milestone aligns with **EN 301 549** standards and reflects our commitment to inclusive design. Our platform now provides enhanced keyboard navigation, screen reader compatibility, improved color contrast, and enhanced compatibility across various assistive technologies.

For more details, read our [blog post](https://kontent.ai/blog/accessible-by-design-creating-inclusive-experiences-with-kontent-ai/) about the importance of accessibility in digital platforms and how Kontent.ai powers these experiences.

searchRecords.title: Efficient migrations with improved Kontent.ai CLI
searchRecords.markdownContent:
The [Kontent.ai CLI](https://github.com/kontent-ai/cli) just got better! We’ve released three improvements to working with migrations:

* Order your migrations by a specific date and time.
* Save and read [status information about executed migrations](https://github.com/kontent-ai/cli#custom-implementation-of-readingsaving-status-of-migrations) from external sources.
* Use the rollback function to account for unsuccessful migrations. ;

For more information, check out the [CLI's README](https://github.com/kontent-ai/cli#readme).

searchRecords.title: Kontent gets a visual refresh!
searchRecords.markdownContent:
App design isn't just about the look but mainly about user experience. We're addressing both aspects and giving Kontent.ai a fresh coat of paint. With the new design, we'll be able to bring you different UI tweaks quicker and speed up your content creation.

Along with the new UI, we've also redesigned our e-learning courses. Check out our [e-learning](/e-learning) to stay up-to-date with Kontent.ai and content creation trends.

searchRecords.title: Under the hood of Kontent
searchRecords.markdownContent: Ever wondered what Kontent runs on? Check out What is behind Kontent for a quick primer on Kontent's architecture and the external services it uses. With this knowledge, you can make better informed decisions when building your own apps.

searchRecords.title: Kontent CLI can run a range of migrations
searchRecords.markdownContent:
With the [Kontent CLI](https://github.com/Kentico/kontent-cli), our migration template runner, you can now run a subset of your migrations based on a range you provide (using the new `range` parameter).

This makes it easier to use migrations in multiple environments. For example, after you clone a partially migrated project, you can run your remaining migrations from the last migration that was executed on the source project. Find more [details in the readme](https://github.com/Kentico/kontent-cli#usage).

searchRecords.title: Kontent CLI improvements
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We've released a new minor version of the [Kontent CLI](https://github.com/Kentico/kontent-cli/ "Kontent CLI v0.1.0"). When restoring a project using the CLI, you can now choose whether you want to publish all content item variants. This is enabled by default.

Also, the Management JS SDK is now a peer dependency of the Kontent CLI, allowing you to choose the version of the SDK that you require in your [migration scripts](https://github.com/Kentico/kontent-migrations-boilerplate).

searchRecords.title: View available localizations of untranslated linked content
searchRecords.markdownContent:
If you’re using fallbacks for linked content in your projects, you can now view which localizations are available for untranslated linked content.

This helps content creators determine which language variant will be delivered to the website or app displaying the content.

searchRecords.title: Filter language variants with advanced criteria
searchRecords.markdownContent:
Quickly find exactly what you need with our new filtering endpoint, now available in early access in Management API:

* Filter by multiple criteria – filter by language, content types, contributors, workflow steps, and taxonomy terms all in one request.
* Flexible sorting options – sort by name, due date, or last modification time in ascending or descending order.
* Control response size – choose to include language variant elements or only system attributes to optimize performance.

The endpoint is available in early access and may evolve before general availability. Use with caution in production environments.

Access through the latest versions of our [JavaScript Management SDK](https://github.com/kontent-ai/management-sdk-js) and [.NET Management SDK](https://github.com/kontent-ai/management-sdk-net).

searchRecords.title: Don't know which folder you've opened the other day? Kontent does!
searchRecords.markdownContent: When inserting images to a content item, the last visited folder is now remembered so there's no need to click through the asset library again and again. Less time searching for assets, more time being creative.

searchRecords.title: Learn portal gets faster, searchable API reference
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We’ve rebuilt the Learn portal’s API reference experience to make finding and navigating API documentation significantly faster and easier.

* **Searchable API reference** – API sections and endpoints are now searchable by name and description. Search results clearly distinguish between API endpoints and other content, showing the API type and HTTP method so you can quickly find what you need.
* **Faster performance** – API reference pages now load near-instantly with background preloading.
* **Improved navigation** – The API reference is now fully integrated with the rest of the Learn portal, making it easier to move between documentation, learning paths, and API references.

We hope you enjoy the improved experience!

searchRecords.title: Legacy webhooks will stop working on September 1, 2025
searchRecords.markdownContent:
Legacy webhooks will reach full end-of-life on **September 1, 2025**. After this date, they will no longer function.

If you use legacy webhooks in your projects, we strongly recommend that you migrate soon to fully take advantage of the default webhook’s enhanced features and avoid disrupting your services. For help with the migration, you can refer to our migration guidelines.

searchRecords.title: Legacy webhooks end-of-life date extended to November 1, 2025
searchRecords.markdownContent:
Based on user feedback, we’re extending the end-of-life date for legacy webhooks from September 1, 2025 to **November 1, 2025**. This gives you additional time to complete your migration without service interruptions.

If you haven’t migrated yet, we encourage you to take advantage of this extension and plan your update accordingly. For guidance, refer to our migration guidelines.

searchRecords.title: Legacy webhooks sunsetted
searchRecords.markdownContent:
As of November 3, 2025, legacy webhooks have been fully removed from the Kontent.ai platform. This marks the completion of the deprecation process announced over a year ago.

What this means:

* Legacy webhooks can no longer be created, edited, or triggered.
* All legacy webhook configurations have been removed from projects.
* Documentation for legacy webhooks has been removed.

Learn more about default webhooks or contact our support team if you need assistance.

searchRecords.title: Maximum length of the collection name increased
searchRecords.markdownContent: Names of collections can now contain up to 200 characters (instead of the original 50) to better support more descriptive titles. On top of that, the collection codename can now also be up to 210 characters long.

searchRecords.title: Environment cloning with version history limitation
searchRecords.markdownContent: When cloning environments with content item version history, the number of versions per content item is now limited to 50\. This change ensures efficient completion of the cloning process, even for environments with extensive version history.

searchRecords.title: Added title to URL links in Delivery and CM API
searchRecords.markdownContent: You can now specify titles for web URL links in _Rich text_ elements to improve SEO of your website. When you specify a link title in the UI, the title will be rendered in the API responses from the Delivery API and Management API v2.

searchRecords.title: Real-time editing experience with live preview in Web Spotlight
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We’re introducing live preview, our latest addition to Web Spotlight, designed to elevate your authoring experience. With live preview for Web Spotlight, developers can provide content creators with real-time feedback on their content changes made in Kontent.ai.

Live preview requires that you use an early access version of the Smart Link SDK. You don’t need to adjust anything in your project settings.

Combined with autorefresh, live preview significantly enhances the user experience when using Preview in Web Spotlight. Check how to [set up your app for the live preview](https://github.com/kontent-ai/smart-link/tree/next?tab=readme-ov-file#live-preview-in-web-spotlight) to give it a try!

searchRecords.title: Live preview now available for everyone!
searchRecords.markdownContent:
You can now see your content changes directly in your items using live preview—no Web Spotlight required. Activate live preview by going to the Environment settings and ensure you meet the security requirements.

For an even smoother experience, use the [Smart Link SDK](https://github.com/kontent-ai/smart-link) to implement automatic refresh and see your edits appear instantly.

You can also use the Management API to ;check whether the live preview's status is currently enabled or disabled for your environment or change its status.

searchRecords.title: Live preview for Web Spotlight is generally available to enhance authoring experience
searchRecords.markdownContent:
The live preview for Web Spotlight is now generally available and supports all elements, including rich text, linked items, and subpages. With live preview, developers can give creators real-time content changes made in Web Spotlight.

Live preview requires the [Smart Link SDK](https://github.com/kontent-ai/smart-link "kontent-ai/smart-link: Kontent.ai Smart Link SDK can be used to automatically inject smart links to Kontent.ai according to manually specified HTML data attributes on your website. It also lets you connect your website with Web Spotlight (for faster editing and preview of your content).") version 3.2.0 or newer.

searchRecords.title: Live preview replaces Web Spotlight
searchRecords.markdownContent:
Live preview replaces Web Spotlight today as the way to visually edit and preview content in Kontent.ai. With live preview, content creators can manage and navigate content, and see changes in real time – all within the same view.

**If you were using Web Spotlight:** your existing preview configurations in Web Spotlight carry over to live preview automatically. Activate live preview to continue working with the same setup.

**If you’re setting up live preview for the first time**: activate live preview and configure it to meet the security requirements. Elevate the experience by setting up spaces to build the navigation hierarchy and by using the [Smartlink SDK](https://github.com/kontent-ai/smart-link) for real-time feedback.

searchRecords.title: Directly edit your content in live preview and build navigation with spaces
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We are thrilled to announce some fantastic enhancements to live preview and spaces, designed to make your content management experience even more seamless and efficient.

**Direct editing with Smart Link SDK**: With the [Smart Link SDK](https://github.com/kontent-ai/smart-link "Smart link SDK"), you can now edit items directly from the live preview. This means you can make real-time changes to your content without leaving the preview mode, saving valuable time.

**Enhanced navigation**: Meet the new navigation tree, where you can effortlessly locate and manage content items, providing a more intuitive and organized way to manage your website’s structure. Add a root item for your space and build your navigation tree.

searchRecords.title: New permission for environments
searchRecords.markdownContent: You can now use a _Manage environments_ permission to let users in your project work with environments. For example, this can be useful if you want to give your developers complete control over your non-production environments.

searchRecords.title: Manage multiple previews with spaces
searchRecords.markdownContent:
With spaces, you can manage multiple websites under one project for easier content reuse. In this first release, we're introducing the option to add multiple previews to a project. Check it out!

You can also manage spaces via Management API.

searchRecords.title: Manage project environments
searchRecords.markdownContent: Environments provide a way to make changes in isolation from your production project. Use environments to prepare changes for your production project in a safe place. Your developers then take care of propagating those changes to production.

searchRecords.title: Manage Web Spotlight via API
searchRecords.markdownContent:
Using Management API, you can now manage Web Spotlight via API. These endpoints make it easier to migrate changes between environments.

With the new endpoints, you can:

* Activate and deactivate Web Spotlight.
* Check whether Web Spotlight is used in a specific environment.
* Specify which content type you want to use for the Web Spotlight root instead of the default.

searchRecords.title: Upload larger assets via API with increased file limit
searchRecords.markdownContent: The Management API now supports uploading files up to 2 GB, matching the limit in the Kontent.ai UI. This gives you more flexibility when migrating assets in bulk or uploading large media files programatically.

searchRecords.title: New scope for Management API rate limits
searchRecords.markdownContent:
The scope of the rate limits for Management API changes from _per user per project_ to _per project_. If you're using retry policy for your API requests, nothing changes for you.

If you're using multiple API keys to make API requests to a single project, you might see more _Too Many Requests_ errors. Don't worry, your apps will keep working.

searchRecords.title: Manage environments via API
searchRecords.markdownContent: Your developers can now use the new Management API endpoints to clone, rename, delete, and mark environments as production. Use the new API endpoints for environment management to automate the creation of new environments and backups.

searchRecords.title: Markdown shorthands in rich text editor
searchRecords.markdownContent: You can now use markdown shorthands to create headings and lists when editing text in the rich text editor.

searchRecords.title: Let AI unify the voice and tone of your content
searchRecords.markdownContent: Want to ensure your content always reflects your brand’s voice and tone? Now, with our newest addition to Ask AI’s change tone, you can align your content’s voice and tone with your brand’s messaging. Focus on creating great content and let AI handle the consistency.

searchRecords.title: Maximum length of the content item name increased
searchRecords.markdownContent: Names of content items can now contain up to 200 characters (instead of original 50) to better support more descriptive titles.

searchRecords.title: Renamed Java, PHP, and Ruby packages
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We've renamed the Kontent.ai open source packages for Java, PHP, and Ruby. This means the packages' major versions were increased. We recommend that you use the latest package versions in your apps.

* Java SDK – [ai.kontent:delivery-sdk](https://s01.oss.sonatype.org/content/groups/public/ai/kontent/delivery-sdk/)
* Java model generator – [ai.kontent:delivery-sdk-generators](https://s01.oss.sonatype.org/content/groups/public/ai/kontent/delivery-sdk-generators/)
* Ruby SDK – [rubygems:kontent-ai-delivery](https://rubygems.org/gems/kontent-ai-delivery)
* PHP SDK – [kontent-ai/delivery-sdk-php](https://packagist.org/packages/kontent-ai/delivery-sdk-php)

For a comprehensive list of changes in the packages, check the ;individual packages' [GitHub releases](https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/releasing-projects-on-github/about-releases) ;on [Kontent.ai GitHub](https://github.com/kontent-ai).

searchRecords.title: Model generator gets a major update
searchRecords.markdownContent:
A new version of the **@kontent-ai/model-generator** is here, bringing expanded support and an even smoother developer experience. This tool helps you generate Typescript models based on Kontent.ai content types, making it easier to work with the Delivery SDK by mapping retrieved content items to their strongly typed models.

What’s new?

* Support for **four model types**: `delivery-sdk`, `migration-toolkit`, `environment`, and `items`
* **Stronger** **type safety** and type guards to prevent runtime issues
* Highly **customizable output** and formatting options
* CLI and programmatic usage with **improved configuration**

Check out the model generator's [GitHub repository](https://github.com/kontent-ai/model-generator-js) or the [NPM package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@kontent-ai/model-generator).

searchRecords.title: Spring updates to GraphQL API
searchRecords.markdownContent:
With the Delivery GraphQL API, you can now:

* Use the new predefined `totalCount` field in collection fields to find how many items the collection contains. Useful for paging!
* Get individual content items by their internal IDs. Useful if you know the item's ID but not its codename.
* See how your queries fare in terms of complexity and resource consumption. The API responses now come with two new headers, `X-Complexity` and `X-Request-Charge`. Use the headers to fine-tune your queries.

searchRecords.title: Streamlined collaboration through improved security
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We’ve introduced filtering users based on their roles in collections. This makes collaboration easier for content creators and enables organizations to better isolate their business units.

This update helps your content creators easily identify and select relevant colleagues they want to mention in comments or assign tasks to. Your project users won’t see other users with whom they don’t share a collection. This helps your organization use collections to securely isolate individual business units and prevent users from seeing who’s in collections they don’t have access to.

For instance, if a user encounters a comment posted by someone whose name they shouldn’t see due to the collection permissions, they won’t. They’ll see the comment but not the name of its author.

searchRecords.title: Multiple brands in one project? New sample project has the answer!
searchRecords.markdownContent:
Explore the new multi-brand sample project and discover best practices for your own projects.

The project is built around a fictional health-tech company that manages three brands and three websites. Check the project to see how to:

* Create landing pages using visual content types.
* Employ content modeling best practices.
* Manage multiple sites within a single project.
* Preview your content in Web Spotlight without leaving Kontent.ai.

searchRecords.title: See the Web Spotlight preview in various resolutions
searchRecords.markdownContent:
You can adjust the preview resolution in Web Spotlight to see how your page works on devices of various sizes!

Select a predefined resolution to know how your pages work on various devices, such as mobile phones or tablets, both in portrait and landscape modes.

You can also **set a custom resolution** using the toolbar above the preview or by dragging the edges of the preview frame.

This update also brings you the option to generate a link to a specific preview setup. You can **share the preview link with coworkers** who have access to the particular page.

In hand with multiple resolutions for Web Spotlight, we’ve also released a **new version of the** [**Smartlink SDK**](https://github.com/kontent-ai/smart-link "GitHub - kontent-ai/smart-link: Kontent.ai Smart Link SDK"). Make sure your developers update the Smartlink SDK to enable sharing preview links.

searchRecords.title: Flexible workflow scopes are here
searchRecords.markdownContent:
Up until now, you could define only one scope rule per workflow. Newly, you can add as many combinations of content types and collections to the rules as you need.

Establish the proper rules that suit your project requirements perfectly without compromises.

searchRecords.title: Multiple workflows
searchRecords.markdownContent:
Step up your content governance with multiple workflows! We know that different types of content often require different workflow steps and approval processes. That's why you can now set up separate workflows for different types of your content. For example, marketing content and legal content can have different workflow steps, transitions, and role permissions.

Get in touch with us, or check out our [pricing page](https://kontent.ai/pricing) for more details.

searchRecords.title: Workflows now available in APIs
searchRecords.markdownContent: When getting your content items from Delivery API or synchronizing changes via Sync API, you can now see which workflow your content items belong to. Use this to filter the content items by specific workflows or to get notified of workflow changes via webhooks.

searchRecords.title: Translate with AI now generally available for all!
searchRecords.markdownContent:
Accelerate your global reach and connect with your audience effortlessly using AI. Activate Translate with AI in the new section found under Environment settings > AI accelerators.

Translate with AI is activated automatically for new projects, ensuring a seamless experience from the start.

searchRecords.title: Navigate comments in a flash!
searchRecords.markdownContent: Switching between multiple comments and suggestions is now simpler than ever. With our new arrow-key navigation, you can quickly move from one comment to the next, saving time and making your content reviews more efficient.

searchRecords.title: New {Collection} macro for preview URLs
searchRecords.markdownContent: Use the new `{Collection}` macro in your preview URLs to differentiate between collections. For example, if you're using collections for multiple regional websites, you can use the new macro to tell your app which website to preview.

searchRecords.title: New .NET sample application
searchRecords.markdownContent:
As part of the .NET stack modernization, we’ve published a matching [sample application](https://github.com/kontent-ai/sample-app-net-mvc "Kontent.ai .NET MVC sample app"). Built as an ASP.NET Core MVC app on top of the Ficto multi-site sample project, the application showcases key features and principles of the updated SDK, including:

* Keyed client configuration for different delivery scenarios.
* Efficient caching with both time-based and webhook-based invalidation.
* A customizable rich text rendering pipeline.
* Reworked strongly typed models and runtime `ITypeProvider` discovery.
* Routing and content retrieval strategies for multi-site solutions.

For a full list of features and installation instructions, see [the application's repository](https://github.com/kontent-ai/sample-app-net-mvc "Kontent.ai .NET MVC sample app repo") on GitHub.

searchRecords.title: Changes to cipher suites supported by Kontent.ai APIs
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We updated the certificate cipher suites used and accepted by all Kontent.ai APIs to support the latest technologies such as [HTTP/3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HTTP/3), [TLS 1.3](https://www.cloudflare.com/learning/ssl/why-use-tls-1.3/), [QUIC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/QUIC), 0-RTT, and [IPv6](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IPv6). While TLS 1.2 remains supported, we've preserved only the cipher suites considered strong enough.

Make sure that the operating system of your servers and apps supports at least one of the following cipher suites: [TLS\_AES\_128\_GCM\_SHA256](https://ciphersuite.info/cs/TLS%5FAES%5F128%5FGCM%5FSHA256/), [TLS\_AES\_256\_GCM\_SHA384](https://ciphersuite.info/cs/TLS%5FAES%5F256%5FGCM%5FSHA384/), [TLS\_CHACHA20\_POLY1305\_SHA256](https://ciphersuite.info/cs/TLS%5FCHACHA20%5FPOLY1305%5FSHA256/), [TLS\_ECDHE\_RSA\_WITH\_AES\_256\_GCM\_SHA384](https://ciphersuite.info/cs/TLS%5FECDHE%5FRSA%5FWITH%5FAES%5F256%5FGCM%5FSHA384/), [TLS\_ECDHE\_RSA\_WITH\_CHACHA20\_POLY1305\_SHA256](https://ciphersuite.info/cs/TLS%5FECDHE%5FRSA%5FWITH%5FCHACHA20%5FPOLY1305%5FSHA256/), [TLS\_ECDHE\_RSA\_WITH\_AES\_128\_GCM\_SHA256](https://ciphersuite.info/cs/TLS%5FECDHE%5FRSA%5FWITH%5FAES%5F128%5FGCM%5FSHA256/).

If you come across any issues or have questions, contact our support.

searchRecords.title: Assets now have codenames
searchRecords.markdownContent:
Aligned with the new webhooks that you can use to track changes in your assets, we’ve added codenames to assets.

You can use the new asset codenames in the UI and via Management API. Soon, we’ll also add asset codenames to Delivery API.

searchRecords.title: New cheat sheets, your shortcuts to success
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We’re thrilled to introduce three new cheat sheets in the Learn portal! These guides are crafted to help you manage complex scenarios with ease and efficiency in Kontent.ai.

Here’s what’s new:

* Content translations: Simplify the process of localizing content for global audiences. Discover strategies ranging from native AI translation to advanced integrations with translation management systems tailored to your business needs.
* Multisite management: Master the art of managing multiple websites from a single platform. Explore approaches like spaces, collections, roles and permissions, and multiple projects to ensure scalability, consistency, and collaboration.
* Publishing metadata: Take control of your publishing schedules and workflows. Learn best practices for managing publish dates and metadata to ensure accurate scheduling, improve SEO, and streamline your content lifecycle​.

Exploring these cheat sheets to make the right decisions with Kontent.ai.

searchRecords.title: Cheat sheets: Your shortcut to success
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We’re excited to announce a big addition to the Learn portal: (even more) cheat sheets! These concise and practical guides are tailored to help you quickly address common scenarios and challenges with Kontent.ai. Here’s what’s available:

* Asset management: Centralize your digital assets to ensure quick access, brand consistency, and seamless collaboration for any project.
* Asset replacement: Learn efficient methods for updating outdated assets across content items while maintaining consistency and saving valuable time for your team.
* Forms and form data: Optimize user interactions with tailored, scalable forms that improve engagement, data collection, and integration with your business tools.
* Content structure and formatting: Build structured, semantically formatted content that boosts readability, engagement, accessibility, and SEO performance.
* Hierarchy in URLs: Leverage hierarchical URLs to improve SEO, enhance user trust, and create a seamless navigation experience across your site.
* Tables and tabular data: Find strategies to present your data clearly and effectively.

Explore our expanded cheat sheets collection and enhance your experience with Kontent.ai.

searchRecords.title: Unlock new possibilities with custom apps
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We’re excited to announce **custom apps**, a powerful new way to integrate and extend the capabilities of Kontent.ai! With custom apps, you can embed full-screen apps directly into your project’s environment, enabling seamless integration with external tools and data sources.

* **Access unified analytics**: Combine CMS data with third-party services for comprehensive dashboards and insights.
* **Centralize workflows**: Manage translation progress, monitor SEO metrics, or track deployments—all without leaving Kontent.ai.
* **Collaborate more effectively**: Bring your teams’ tools directly into the CMS, ensuring smoother workflows and faster results.
* **Enhance content management**: Build tailored views of your content, such as taxonomies or untranslated items, to streamline tasks.

Start building your custom apps today to unlock the full potential of your content operations!

searchRecords.title: New Delivery .NET SDK allows registering multiple clients
searchRecords.markdownContent: We've released version 15 of the Delivery .NET SDK. This version lets you register multiple Delivery clients in a single project. Also, you can now retrieve information about project languages and view workflow steps of content items. Find more in the [SDK release notes](https://github.com/Kentico/kontent-delivery-sdk-net/releases/tag/15.0.0).

searchRecords.title: Improved error handling in the Delivery .NET SDK
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We've released a new version of the Delivery .NET SDK. The main improvement is that the Delivery client now correctly forwards error responses from the Delivery API instead of just failing without providing meaningful information. This concerns mainly data listing requests.

It's now significantly more convenient to properly handle the data retrieval error cases so we strongly recommend upgrading your SDK to the new version.

Check out [release notes on GitHub](https://github.com/Kentico/kontent-delivery-sdk-net/releases/tag/16.0.1) for details and tips on how to upgrade to this version.

searchRecords.title: New e-learning is here!
searchRecords.markdownContent:
From now on, you can use our set of e-learning courses available right here in the e-learning section. Pick the right course for you or for your colleagues to become a Kontent master.

E-learning is part of Kontent's [Customer Success Services](https://kontent.ai/services). Partner agencies have free access using their accounts from Partner subscriptions.

searchRecords.title: New filtering operators for Delivery API
searchRecords.markdownContent: When getting your content from Delivery API, you can now use new filtering operators. For all values, you can use `[empty]` (element has no value) and `[nempty]` (element has value). For non-array values like strings and numbers, you can use `[eq]` (same as `=`), `[neq]` (value doesn't equal the specified value), and `[nin]` (element value is not in the specified list of values).

searchRecords.title: Languages available in Delivery API
searchRecords.markdownContent: Use the new /languages endpoint to get a list of your project's active languages through the Delivery API. For example, you can take the list of languages you get from the API and use it to create a dynamic language selector in your apps.

searchRecords.title: New path: Effective AI Agent prompting
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We’ve added a new learning path to help content teams get better, more consistent results from the AI Agent. ;

Effective AI Agent prompting walks content managers and creators through six practical prompting principles that reduce trial‑and‑error and improve the quality of AI‑generated outcomes. The guidance is tailored to real‑world tasks such as bulk updates, discovery queries, and SEO improvements, so teams can use the Agent with more confidence from day one.

searchRecords.title: Choose the types of content items links
searchRecords.markdownContent:
When editing content types, you can now limit the types of content items links. You can also quickly preselect all content types with URL slug elements.

With proper item link limitations, your content creators save time by choosing only from the items that can be linked. No need to think twice when adding links.

searchRecords.title: New macros for preview URLs
searchRecords.markdownContent: You can now use two new macros while defining preview URLs for your content types. The new `{Codename}` macro resolves to the codename of a content item and the `{ItemId}` macro resolves to the internal ID of a content item.

searchRecords.title: New guide on content personalization
searchRecords.markdownContent: We've introduced a new introductory guide on ;content personalization. The guide walks you through the steps you need to take to provide personalized content experiences for your users and customers in the digital realm.

searchRecords.title: Smarter search, better results
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We’ve moved semantic search to a new location and improved capabilities that make searching easier for what you’re looking for.

Now, you can:

* Ask natural questions
* Use broad or descriptive phrases
* Discover insights and opportunities that might have been hard to spot before

Our AI-powered search understands the context of your query and delivers the most relevant results – ;fast.

If you’ve enabled semantic search, you’ll see **Search** at the top-left of the navigation. Otherwise, you can activate the smarter search experience in the Innovation Lab.

searchRecords.title: New team and collaboration guides
searchRecords.markdownContent: After new content modeling guides were introduced in April, we’re extending the _Set up Kontent.ai_ section with a new set of tutorials on setting up your team and collaboration within the team. The tutorials cover different topics like role configuration, establishing a workflow, adding multilingual or regional content, and setting up a collaboration process in your team.

searchRecords.title: Experience our new interactive trial – now live!
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We’re excited to announce a major update to the Kontent.ai trial experience, designed to help you hit the ground running. Here’s what’s new:

* **Guided, self-paced learning** – explore hands-on learning paths that guide you step by step through essential features of Kontent.ai.
* **Hands-on practice with Kickstart** – put your learning into action with Kickstart, a sample project where you’ll complete real-world examples from the lessons.

Start your free trial today and see the difference Kontent.ai can make for your organization!

searchRecords.title: Need to translate at scale?
searchRecords.markdownContent:
Ensure consistent and accurate translations, even at large scale! Check our new guide on integrating a translation management system with your Kontent.ai project.

Make ;the right decisions so that the translation process works just the way you want.

searchRecords.title: New Delivery SDK with .NET 6 support
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We released [version 16 of the Delivery .NET SDK](https://github.com/Kentico/kontent-delivery-sdk-net/releases/tag/16.0.0) to bring you the following improvements.

* Use the new SDK with your [.NET 6 projects](https://github.com/Kentico/kontent-delivery-sdk-net#kontent-delivery-net-sdk).
* Retrieve asset renditions. You can also [configure the default preset to be applied](https://github.com/Kentico/kontent-delivery-sdk-net/wiki/Registering-the-DeliveryClient-to-the-IServiceCollection-in-ASP.NET-Core#standard-usage).
* Enumerating items via feed now supports a [custom feed start position](https://github.com/Kentico/kontent-delivery-sdk-net/wiki/Enumerating-all-items), which gives you control over paging.
* When naming properties of your strongly typed data models, you can [enrich them with the PropertyNameAttribute ;attribute](https://github.com/Kentico/kontent-delivery-sdk-net/wiki/Working-with-strongly-typed-models#naming-the-properties) if you need to use a different element codename.
* Find relevant code faster with reorganized SDK namespaces.

Check out [release details on GitHub](https://github.com/Kentico/kontent-delivery-sdk-net/releases/tag/16.0.0) with tips on how to upgrade to the latest version.

searchRecords.title: New .NET model generator
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We've released a new [version 7 of the .NET model generator](https://github.com/Kentico/kontent-generators-net/). It's compatible with the latest versions of the .NET SDKs for Management API and Delivery API.

Check out [release details on GitHub](https://github.com/Kentico/kontent-generators-net/releases/tag/7.0.0).

searchRecords.title: Your webhooks, now with custom headers
searchRecords.markdownContent:
When setting up your webhooks, you can now specify custom webhook headers! This means webhook notifications can contain extra context and metadata of your choice.

With custom headers, you can easily authenticate your webhook notifications against your endpoints or firewalls. You can also use the headers to differentiate between webhooks and enhance your integrations.

searchRecords.title: Easily track content changes with new webhooks
searchRecords.markdownContent:
The new improved webhooks experience is now available to all customers. Use the new webhooks to track changes in assets, content items, content types, languages, and taxonomies. For more precise notifications, you can filter content item events by content types, collections, and languages.

But that's not all! Stay tuned for custom headers, extra filtering options, and more in the upcoming year.

The new webhooks ;are available for all new subscriptions as the default. You'll find your existing webhooks labeled as legacy. We're going to support legacy webhooks until further notice. You don't need to take any action.

searchRecords.title: New year, new courses... 8 of them!
searchRecords.markdownContent:
You can now go through eight new E-learning courses explaining concepts to different audiences. Which will you go through?

* _What's content reuse in 5 minutes_ introduces the content reuse concept to anyone who wants to know more.
* _Content modeling essentials_ is a how-to for content modeling beginners, typically architects of the system.
* _Set up Web Spotlight_ guides architects and developers through Web Spotlight's configuration.
* _Using taxonomies in Kontent.ai_ complements our existing domain course, Taxonomies explained. The new course showcases content managers and architects how to set up and use taxonomies in Kontent.ai.
* _Set up permissions_ walks content managers and architects through Kontent.ai's permission model.
* _First steps with Delivery API_ is the intro for developers that tackle Kontent.ai, as it shows how to display content in a front-end application.
* _Upserting content with webhooks_ is also for developers, but this time about webhooks with a pinch of Management API – a combination useful in most real-world projects.
* _Migrate content to Kontent.ai with CLI_ showcases to developers how to migrate content from the previous CMS with a command-line interface.

The first two courses are available for everyone after sign-up, while the rest is available for subscriptions with [E-learning activated](https://kontent.ai/e-learning/) and [partner](https://kontent.ai/partners/solutions/) subscriptions.

searchRecords.title: Reuse asset elements across languages
searchRecords.markdownContent:
You can now mark asset elements as ;non-localizable to ensure they have the same values across all languages.

Non-localizable elements are available through the early access program. Let us know if you'd like to try!

searchRecords.title: Want to reuse elements in another language?
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We've added support for non-localizable elements. This means you can mark certain types of elements as non-localizable, ensuring the elements will have the same value in all languages.

Non-localizable elements are currently available through early access program. Let us know if you'd like to try!

searchRecords.title: Non-localizable elements generally available
searchRecords.markdownContent: Non-localizable elements are now out of early access and available to everyone. This means you can mark specific content elements as non-localizable to ensure the elements have the same value in all languages.

searchRecords.title: Reuse linked items and subpages elements across languages
searchRecords.markdownContent:
You can now mark linked items and subpages elements as ;non-localizable to ensure they have the same values across all languages.

Non-localizable elements are available through the early access program. Let us know if you'd like to try!

searchRecords.title: Reuse taxonomy elements across languages
searchRecords.markdownContent:
You can now mark taxonomy elements as ;non-localizable to ensure they have the same values across all languages.

Non-localizable elements are available through the early access program. Let us know if you'd like to try!

searchRecords.title: Translate your non-localizable elements
Reuse URL slugs and custom elements across languages
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We've extended support for non-localizable elements. ;You can now mark URL slugs and custom elements as non-localizable to ensure the elements have the same values across all languages.

Non-localizable elements are available through the early access program. Let us know if you'd like to try!

searchRecords.title: Optimize images for any channel
searchRecords.markdownContent: We've put together an image optimization guide that will walk you through the most common methods for optimizing images on any device. This can help you produce faster-loading images and save you quite a lot of bandwidth.

searchRecords.title: The guide on SEO now better, shorter, faster
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We gave our content optimization guide a make-over to make it more to the point, better structured, and easier to read.

If you're running a website as a part of your project, search engine optimization, a.k.a. SEO, is surely a big topic for you.

searchRecords.title: Relations now shows your content navigation tree
searchRecords.markdownContent: Relations now includes a navigation tree view, giving you a clearer picture of how your content is linked. Select a root item or space to see all content connected to it – or switch the _Subpages_ toggle on to focus on the navigation tree only.

searchRecords.title: Introducing personalized learning: All you need to know on one page!
searchRecords.markdownContent:
Starting to learn about a new platform can be a challenging task. You might feel overwhelmed about where to even begin or how long it’s gonna take to get onboarded. That’s where we come in! With the new personalized learning, all you need to do is [pick one of the personas](https://kontent.ai/learn):

* Manager
* Content creator
* Developer

…and we’ll build your personalized learning page for you! You’ll be able to see which content is relevant for you, how long it’s gonna take to complete each level, and what kind of progress you’ve already made – all in one page. Go to your **Profile** in the top right corner of our Learn portal to experience it for yourself!

searchRecords.title: Phone links now available in rich text
searchRecords.markdownContent: Need to enable your customers to easily call you directly from your app? That's a piece of cake now. Add phone links directly from the rich text editor in Kontent.ai. You can also insert phone links using Management API.

searchRecords.title: New Delivery PHP SDK with support for PHP 8
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We've released a new version of the [Delivery PHP SDK](https://github.com/Kentico/kontent-delivery-sdk-php) that targets PHP 8\. We've also updated the [sample PHP app](https://github.com/Kentico/kontent-sample-app-php). If you're on Windows, you might like the tutorial on [windows-based PHP development](https://github.com/Kentico/kontent-delivery-sdk-php/wiki/Developing-PHP-in-Visual-Studio-Code-for-Dummies).

We recommend you upgrade to the latest SDK version because [PHP 7.4 is currently in Security Support](https://www.php.net/supported-versions.php) and nears its end of life.

searchRecords.title: Turn rich text HTML into portable text or JSON
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We've released an open-source rich text resolver for JavaScript available as `@kontent-ai/rich-text-resolver`. Check out [examples of use on GitHub](https://github.com/kontent-ai/rich-text-resolver-js).

The resolver is an alternative to the rich text resolution in the Delivery JS SDK. Use the resolver to transform the rich text HTML into a tree structure and transform the tree structure to the [portable text standard](https://github.com/portabletext/portabletext) that’s supported by the majority of popular frameworks such as React, Svelte, Vue.js.

searchRecords.title: Preselected collection when linking items
searchRecords.markdownContent:
When linking content items in rich text or linked items elements, the content list will be prefiltered to the collection of the parent content item.

This little change helps you select from the content that's relevant to what you're editing and save time.

searchRecords.title: Workflow preselection saves your time
searchRecords.markdownContent:
When you change an item's workflow and there's only one workflow the item can move to, Kontent now disables the dropdown and ;selects the workflow for you automatically. ;

It works the same when you convert a component to a content item and there's only one workflow available.

searchRecords.title: Preview API requests counted in API Calls and Bandwidth metrics
searchRecords.markdownContent:
Starting January 15, 2024, billing reports include the Delivery Preview API requests in the API Calls and Bandwidth metrics. These are requests for previewing the latest and unpublished content, such as assets and content items.

This means you might see a slight increase in the API Calls and Bandwidth metrics based on your content preview usage.

searchRecords.title: Project manager becomes global
searchRecords.markdownContent:
The Project manager role is now global for your whole project. When assigning this role to users, you need to assign the role to all languages and all collections. You can still create a custom role with the desired permissions and access restrictions.

If you assigned the Project manager role to a user and limited it to a specific collection or language, we'll migrate the role assignment ;for you.

searchRecords.title: Guide to a smooth content migration
searchRecords.markdownContent:
Migrating your content can be quite an adventure. That’s why we’ve created our new learning path, Migrate from other systems, to help you make the journey smoother for everyone involved. ;

The learning path is packed with all the tips and tricks developers need to tackle migrations efficiently and without hassle.

You'll learn:

* Who needs to be on board, and at what stage of the migration project.
* How to assess existing content and move it to a new system.
* How to align your content with the new model or system.
* Everything you need to get your new project off the ground smoothly.

searchRecords.title: Get a glance at your recently published items
searchRecords.markdownContent:
Mission Control’s dashboard has a new addition where you can overview items published recently. You can:

* Quickly scan what content went live and when.
* Plan smarter by tracking the publishing cadence and fine-tuning your editorial calendar.
* Quickly gather the insights to inform teams of what content has been published.

Stay on top of your content planning with ease!

searchRecords.title: Publish contents of non-localizable elements in one go
searchRecords.markdownContent:
If you're publishing a content item in non-default language and the item contains non-localizable elements, you can now choose to publish the item's default variant together with the non-default variant in a single action.

With this small improvement, you can easily keep your non-localizable elements up-to-date in your published content.

searchRecords.title: Put another notch on your belt with the new Content Modeling Certification
searchRecords.markdownContent:
Here’s your chance to shine brighter as a content modeling star than ever before! Prove your mettle and showcase your expertise by earning our new Content Modeling Certification for our partner agencies and show the world you can be the mastermind behind content models.

Dedicating just 40 minutes to our comprehensive test will give you a prestigious certification valid for two years. Seize the moment, raise your expertise to new heights, and let the world know you’re a content modeling champion! The certification is currently accessible exclusively only by our partner agencies.

searchRecords.title: Enhancing API security with rate limits
searchRecords.markdownContent:
To enhance security and ensure reliable service for all customers, we’ve introduced additional rate limits at the CDN level for uncached requests across all Kontent.ai public APIs.

* Delivery REST AP, Delivery GraphQL API, and Sync API  
  * **1,000** ;requests per second
  * **5,000** ;requests per 10 seconds
  * **15,000** ;requests per minute
* Management API and Subscription API  
  * **300** requests per second
  * **2,000** requests per 10 seconds
  * **6,000** requests per minute

Rate limits control the number of requests clients can make within specific timeframes, serving as a critical defense against Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks and other availability threats. This ensures our APIs remain accessible and efficient even during high traffic periods or malicious activity, safeguarding the integrity of your application.

searchRecords.title: Introducing a new era of Kontent.ai
searchRecords.markdownContent:
Get ready to embark on a vibrant journey with us! We’re thrilled to announce that ;Kontent.ai is stepping into a new era with a bold new website, messaging, logo, and color scheme. Our reimagined brand reflects our commitment to meet your content needs and help you achieve an unparalleled return on your content.

Discover what’s new at Kontent.ai and how we see the future of content management in our [press release](https://www.kontent.ai/press/a-new-era-of-content-with-kontent-ai).

searchRecords.title: Reference asset folders by their codenames
searchRecords.markdownContent:
When using the Management API to handle asset folders, you can now reference them by their codenames to uniquely identify the exact folders you’re working on. Using the codename, you can:

* Add asset folders
* Modify asset folders
* Add an asset to a specific folder
* Upsert an asset in a specified folder

searchRecords.title: Become a certified developer!
searchRecords.markdownContent:
Unleash your potential with our brand-new Developer Certification! Show others that you can develop apps and integrate with Kontent.ai.

We’ve revamped the exam questions and sprinkled in some fresh ones, all designed to challenge your knowledge and showcase your expertise in Kontent.ai and its APIs. This is your chance to shine and demonstrate what you truly know!

searchRecords.title: Start with Web Spotlight in a jiffy
searchRecords.markdownContent:
See how your content will be represented in the world without having to push it out into the world! Quickly enable your content creators and marketers with Hello Web Spotlight.

You’ll learn everything you need to get the basics right and provide an interactive authoring experience for your content creators.

searchRecords.title: Regex validation unleashed – now in the UI!
searchRecords.markdownContent:
Recently, we released regex validation support in the Management API v2. Now, you can set the regex validation for text elements directly in the Kontent UI!

On top of that, you can also create custom validation messages. This is a handy tool to let your content creators know how to fill in the text elements to meet the set requirements. Say goodbye to typos in your e-mails, URLs, or phone numbers!

searchRecords.title: Regex validation ease of use and control over URL slugs
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We've added a few improvements to validation by regular expressions to make your life easier. Firstly, you can now use regular expressions to validate your URL slugs. This gives you more control over how your URLs are built. ;

Secondly, you can choose from commonly used regular expressions ;directly in Kontent when you're setting up regex validation on content elements. ;This helps you to speed up the process of setting up the validations because you don't need to reinvent the wheel.

searchRecords.title: August in Kontent Docs
searchRecords.markdownContent:
In August, not only can you read all the materials for Web Spotlight, including a blog post on [transitioning to headless CMS for a seamless multisite experience](https://kontent.ai/blog/use-web-spotlight-with-your-existing-kontent-projects), but you can also check other new materials. When you’re about to migrate existing content, let us introduce you to the importing to Kontent. Choose from our tools or pick the API.

If you’re a developer, check out how you can filter content items when you retrieve them through the Delivery API. This article lists eleven examples in different scenarios using all the programming languages you can easily use.

searchRecords.title: New guides on starting with setting up Kontent
searchRecords.markdownContent: In the last few months, we've introduced new guides on content modeling and the configuration of team collaborations features. This time, we created introductory tutorials on setting up your project and assets.

searchRecords.title: Option to remove deprecated API keys
searchRecords.markdownContent:
If you've already started using the new personal API keys for Management API, you can now remove the deprecated API key using the **Remove key** button.

The deprecated API key remains available and valid until April 30, 2023\. We recommend you switch to the new personal API keys before that date.

searchRecords.title: Reorder elements and taxonomies through API
searchRecords.markdownContent:
Have you ever needed to programmatically reorder the terms in your taxonomies or elements in your content types? With the new `move` operation in Management API, you can do just that! For example, this is handy when you need to sync changes between environments or ensure a consistent order.

The `move` operation is available for the following endpoints:

* Modify a content type
* Modify a content type snippet
* Modify a taxonomy group

searchRecords.title: Request conflict resolution in Management API
searchRecords.markdownContent: The Management API may now return a `409` _Conflict_ status code whenever a single resource (such as content type or snippet) is modified via multiple requests at the same time.

searchRecords.title: Restore multiple content items at once
searchRecords.markdownContent: If you have multiple items in the Archived workflow step and you need to start working on them again, you can now select these items in your content items list and move them to the first step your role can work with using the Restore action.

searchRecords.title: Get published variants with Management API
searchRecords.markdownContent:
Have you ever needed to work with only the published versions of your content in your integrations?

You can now explicitly request the published version of a language variant using Management API.

searchRecords.title: View scheduled publish and unpublish times via API
searchRecords.markdownContent:
When working with language variants via Management API, you can now view information about the variant’s scheduled publish and unpublish dates and times.

With this information, you can always programmatically check whether a language variant is scheduled for publishing or unpublishing.

searchRecords.title: Revamped Management API keys
searchRecords.markdownContent:
You can now use new Management API keys for your apps and integrations!

Compared to the existing Personal API keys that inherit permissions of their owner, Management API keys are:

* Standalone. They aren’t tied to any user. This means easier API key maintenance.
* Customizable. Each Management API key can be limited to specific environments and provide specific permissions.
* Many. You can create as many Management API keys as you need. One for each integration.

searchRecords.title: Rich text resolver now has scoped packages for better integration
searchRecords.markdownContent:
We’ve transitioned [rich-text-resolver](https://github.com/kontent-ai/rich-text-resolver-js) ;to a monorepo architecture with separate scoped packages for streamlined dependency management and improved integration efficiency across your solutions. ;

The rich-text-resolver 3.0.0 release includes the following packages available on [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/):

* [@kontent-ai/rich-text-resolver](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@kontent-ai/rich-text-resolver) – ;Converts Kontent.ai rich text HTML into portable text.
* [@kontent-ai/rich-text-resolver-html](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@kontent-ai/rich-text-resolver-html) – Tools to convert portable text into HTML or Management API HTML.
* [@kontent-ai/rich-text-resolver-markdown](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@kontent-ai/rich-text-resolver-markdown) – Turns portable text into Markdown for AI fine-tuning or quick documentation.
* [@kontent-ai/rich-text-resolver-react](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@kontent-ai/rich-text-resolver-vue) – A React component and utilities for rendering portable text with implementation details specific to Kontent.ai.
* [@kontent-ai/rich-text-resolver-vue](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@kontent-ai/rich-text-resolver-vue) – Utilities to help render portable text in Vue.js.

See the [changelog in our GitHub repository](https://github.com/kontent-ai/rich-text-resolver-js/blob/main/packages/rich-text-resolver/CHANGELOG.md) for detailed updates. You can also check out the learning path on how to resolve rich text and linked content.
